Team - putting this thread together to finalize the inbound invite + RSVP nurture for the July 'Inference Playbook' workshop. I need approvals by EOD Monday so we can kick the send on Wednesday.

1) Send windows (target times by region):
   - US: Wed 11:00 PT (midweek open rates)
   - EU: Wed 10:30 BST
   - APAC: Thur 09:30 SGT (separate send with local subject)

2) Reminder cadence (automated): T-14 (initial invite), T-7 (content highlight + speaker quote), T-2 (urgent reminder + calendar add), T-0 (same-day quick reminder). For priority accounts add a 1:1 follow-up from AE 48 hours after initial send.

3) Copy variants (short & clear):
   A) Product-Led (developer friendly) - short subject suggestions: "Hands-on: Cut LLM inference cost by 3x" / "Workshop: LLM serving patterns for scale"
   Body (short): "Join our hands-on workshop to see how teams reduce token cost and stabilize SLOs using autoscaling, prefix caching, and quantized models. Seats limited - RSVP."

   B) Technical Deep-Dive (target engineers/infra):
   Subject ideas: "Inside a production inference stack: batching, caching, fallbacks"
   Body (snippet): "We will walk through kernel selection, dynamic batching, and KV-cache strategies with real telemetry and before/after cost numbers. Bring a prompt to test in the lab."

   C) Executive / Procurement (short):
   Subject: "Reduce inference unit cost without sacrificing latency - live playbook"
   Body: "Practical checklist, expected unit-economics impact, and procurement ready signals for dedicated vs hosted deployments."

4) Tracking link matrix (initial):
   - US invite (dev): https://short.redwood/infplay?utm_campaign=infplay_july&utm_region=us&utm_seg=dev
   - EU invite (dev): https://short.redwood/infplay?utm_campaign=infplay_july&utm_region=eu&utm_seg=dev
   - Priority accounts (AE nurture link): https://short.redwood/infplay?utm_campaign=infplay_july&utm_tier=priority

Attachments: invite_v1.html, utm_map_v3.xlsx (contains full UTM mapping).

Ask: Marissa - please pick preferred subject lines (A/B for US send). Ben - confirm priority account list and whether we want a separate subject for APAC. Laura - confirm calendar invite (ICS) and any partner co-branding language needed for the sponsor mention.

Thanks,
